output.diagnosis: Chronically slow but reliable payer with no dispute signal. All five prior invoices were paid in full, each settled well past terms (34 to 69 days late). This invoice is 71 days past due, no contacts have been made, no payer notes, replies, or promise are recorded. Accounts Receivable
drafted_message.subject: Reminder: invoice ASH-2026-0050 is past due

output.reasoning: No contact has been attempted yet, so an initial, low-pressure nudge is the proportionate first step; silence here is unexplained rather than evidence of dispute or distress. Nothing in the record shows a missing document, quality objection, already-paid claim, or request for relief that would call for human judgement, and there is no stated cycle or unexpired promise that would justify waiting. A gentle service reminder to the proprietor is the least escalatory option that could still surface a reason for the delay; if a reply reveals a dispute or cash-flow difficulty, that would change the picture.
